name: TeamStarWolf - Ransomware Family Techniques
description: Rule: A live ATT&CK Enterprise technique is in the layer when at least one ATT&CK software entry whose description's first sentence contains the word "ransomware" uses it; the score is the number of those software entries that use it. Computed by the library from its own data with the rule above; this is not an official MITRE mapping or MITRE's assessment. 186 techniques, ATT&CK Enterprise v20.0. Each technique is shown under all of its tactics. Source: data/attack/software_profiles.jsonl (description, techniques). Generated by scripts/build_navigator_layers.py.
